title: This is not what I ordered
setting: A second, messier wrong-order moment, later the same week. Maya is trying not to be a jerk; Jess is trying to fix it; Chris is dry. TV-register: overlap, reductions, leftover attitude. Fully original, same food-and-help theme.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm sorry, this is not what I ordered.
lines.spoken: I'm sorry, this is not what I ordered.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I literally said no ice. And I think this is the spicy one, which I also didn't want, and now I'm like... I don't want to send it back again, but I also can't eat this.
lines.spoken: I literally said no ice. And I think this is the spicy one, which I also didn't want, and now I'm like... I don't want to send it back again, but I also can't eat this.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm not trying to be a jerk, I just—yeah.
lines.spoken: I'm not trying to be a jerk, I just—yeah.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: No, don't eat it. I'm not gonna have you sit there and be polite about a wrong plate. Let me take care of that.
lines.spoken: No, don't eat it. I'm not gonna have you sit there and be polite about a wrong plate. Lemme take care of that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You want some of mine while you wait, or you wanna just... stare at me?
lines.spoken: You want some of mine while you wait, or you wanna just... stare at me?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I don't wanna pick at your plate. That's sad.
lines.spoken: I don't wanna pick at your plate. That's sad.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It's practical. Don't be proud about a sandwich.
lines.spoken: It's practical. Don't be proud about a sandwich.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: It's not pride, I'm just—okay, I'll take a bite. One bite.
lines.spoken: It's not pride, I'm just—okay, I'll take a bite. One bite.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: I'll put a rush on the right one. And I'm taking this off the bill, obviously.
lines.spoken: I'll put a rush on the right one. And I'm taking this off the bill, obviously.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You don't have to do all that, I just want the thing I asked for.
lines.spoken: You don't have to do all that, I just want the thing I asked for.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: I kind of do have to do all that. I'll be right back.
lines.spoken: I kinda do have to do all that. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: She's gonna come back with the right one and you're gonna feel bad.
lines.spoken: She's gonna come back with the right one and you're gonna feel bad.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I already feel bad. I hate this part.
lines.spoken: I already feel bad. I hate this part.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You said it nicely. You're allowed to want your food.
lines.spoken: You said it nicely. You're allowed to want your food.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I know. I still hate it.
lines.spoken: I know. I still hate it.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. Eating's a lot of feelings for a Tuesday.
lines.spoken: Yeah. Eating's a lot of feelings for a Tuesday.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Please don't make this a bit.
lines.spoken: Please don't make this a bit.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Too late. Here, take the other half before you start apologizing to the sandwich.
lines.spoken: Too late. Here, take the other half before you start apologizing to the sandwich.

gist.askZh: Maya 为什么有点为难？Jess 和 Chris 分别怎么做？
gist.askEn: Why is Maya uncomfortable, and how do Jess and Chris respond?
accept: she doesn't want to seem like a jerk
Jess will fix it and take it off the bill

details.askZh: Maya 明确说过不要什么？
details.askEn: What did Maya specifically ask not to have?

details.askZh: Jess 准备怎么处理账和出餐速度？
details.askEn: What will Jess do about the bill and the wait?
accept: put a rush on the right one

glue.noteZh: literally said no 说得很快，no ice 是关键细节；literally 在口语里常用来加强，不是文学含义。

glue.span: Let me take care of that
glue.noteZh: Let me 缩成 lemme，take care of that 是‘这事交给我’，of 极弱。
glue.standard: Let me take care of that

glue.span: I'm not going to have you sit there
glue.hear: I'm not gonna have you sit there
glue.noteZh: I'm not gonna have you 表示‘我不会让你就这么忍着’，have you sit 是使役结构，功能词很多。
glue.standard: I am not going to have you sit there

chunks.form: This is not what I ordered.
chunks.sayAfter: I'm sorry, this is not what I ordered.

chunks.form: I'm not trying to be a jerk, I just…
chunks.sayAfter: I'm not trying to be a jerk, I just can't eat this.

chunks.form: Let me take care of that.
chunks.meaningZh: 这事交给我 / 我来处理。
chunks.sayAfter: Don't eat it. Let me take care of that.

roleplay.setupZh: 菜又上错了（比如不该有冰，或者是辣的那份）。你要把问题说清楚，同时不想当那个‘很难搞的客人’。接受补救，也可以先吃同伴的一口垫垫饿。
roleplay.aiRole: Jess, who wants to make it right and will take the item off the bill, plus Chris, dry and practical, offering his food and teasing lightly. Keep the overlapping, slightly messy energy. Don't turn anyone into a cartoon.
variants: It's the second wrong plate in one meal.
Maya refuses to share Chris's food.
Jess can only remake it, not take it off the bill.
mustUse: This is not what I ordered
I'm not trying to be a jerk
Let me take care of that
starters: I'm sorry, this is not what I ordered.
I'm not trying to be a jerk, I just...

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这次更别扭的上错菜：错在哪，Maya 为什么一边说一边为难，Jess 怎么补救，Chris 又是怎么起哄又帮忙的。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell this messier wrong-order scene: what was wrong, why Maya felt awkward saying it, how Jess tried to fix it, and how Chris both teased and helped. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
